def fn(t0, t1, k, lst, dct):
    v1 = t0.select(2, 1)
    v2 = t1.unfold(2, 1, 4)
    idx3 = torch.tensor([0], device=v2.device)
    v2.index_fill_(1, idx3, -5)
    t0.add_(t0)
    v4 = v1.t()
    v5 = t1.unsqueeze(0).expand(2, 2, 2, 6)
    lst.append(t0)
    v2[1] = 0
    v6 = v2[1::2, :, :, :]
    return (v1, v2, lst, dct)
